foreground_required: typeText (action 2) in CU Fixture Target — CU Fixture Target needs keyboard_input, which requires granted foreground delivery. It will not be retried automatically.
The refused action may still have reached the app; observe before continuing. Earlier actions in this call were delivered.
Foreground input for CU Fixture Target needs a host-issued grant that the model cannot issue: the user can set PI_COMPUTER_USE_FOREGROUND_GRANT=com.choco-pi.FocusFixture (comma-separated bundle ids) or add "com.choco-pi.FocusFixture" to "foreground_grant" in .pi/computer-use.json, then restart pi.
Call observe_ui for a fresh state before the next act_ui.
